title: Eco-House-Build - Volod Hendrix

Eco-House-Build - Volod Hendrix

# Our Eco Passive House Build Journey!

We're building a 70m2 house in the North East of Romania, Iasi and we're covering the whole process, start to finish. We have this project in our heads since a few years now and it is finally the right moment to make it come to life ! ( 2021 )

The House is made of wood using wood fibber sheets and wool as insulation materials. Metal panels are used on the roof and the north wall of the house to protect from strong winds, cold and snow during the winter.

After many nomadic years of travelling Europe we are finally building our first base camp. A place to call Home, a place to come back to and hide, heal, rest.
